name: Web-Check
description: An all-in-one website inspector: type an address and it reports DNS records, TLS chain, headers, cookies, open ports, trackers, redirects, carbon footprint and more, each from a check run from this server. Some checks use third-party APIs and stay empty until their keys are added as variables.

access.note: Web-Check has no accounts: anyone who can open the address can make this server scan any site they name. Keep it behind the deployment's password protection unless you mean to offer it publicly.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address the page is opened at; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The page and the API each check calls
